title: Build Title
tagline: Short one-line description shown in the site shell.
summary: A slightly fuller summary of what the build is and why it matters.
whyThisExists: This appears in the modal as the core rationale. Explain the problem or tension the build addresses.
whatChanged: This appears in the modal as the change log for v1.1 / v1.2 refinement.
Use short concrete bullets describing what improved or sharpened.
artDirection: This appears in the modal as the visual direction note. State whether default Night Lab direction was used or intentionally overridden.
nextMove: This appears in the modal as the next step. Describe the most meaningful next refinement.
promotionRead: This appears in the modal as the promotion assessment. Example: Not yet. / Maybe. / Strong promotion candidate.
